notes: Case temperature 0–70°C without air flow. Optical transmission distance 2–500 m (Recommended Operating Conditions). Power dissipation <20 W (typical 18 W). FEC required to be implemented by the host. Receiver sensitivity -3.4 dBm (OMA) per lane per Note 2 (PRBS31Q, BER 2.4×10⁻⁴); alternate limits vs TECQ/TDECQ stated in table. Stressed receiver sensitivity (OMAouter) -0.9 dBm per lane. LRO module does not have an RX CDR. Wavelength assignment 1304.5–1317.5 nm suitable for all channels (Note 3). Link power budget typ 6.5 dB for maximum TDECQ; allocation for penalties 3.5 dB for maximum TDECQ.
